_doc: Each step: wait = regex on the terminal screen, keys = typed in order (<enter>, <down>, <esc>, <ctrl-c> are named keys), delay = seconds after the pattern shows, repeat = number of successive appearances answered. Adjust patterns after the hooks and CLI tasks without touching code. Hermes approval panel: choices once / session / always / deny, 'Enter' takes the preselected first (once), three <down> then <enter> picks Deny.
